Card Q&A.a: This effect trashes an Option card that was placed by a "place this card in the battle area" effect.
Card Q&A.q: What does the "trash 1 Option card in your opponent's battle area" effect do, exactly?

Effect: [Main] Your Digimon in the breeding area may digivolve into [Lucemon] in your trash without paying the cost. Then, place this card in the battle area.

・By digivolving 1 of your Digimon with [Lucemon] in its name into a Digimon card with [Lucemon] in its name in the trash with the digivolution cost reduced by 3, trash 1 of your opponent's Option cards in the battle area.
Security Effect: [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
